<text:style bold="true">References</text:style>

<image:base64 col="0" width="13" wrap="none"></image:base64>

The reference objects are guides: they can be used for the quotes, the constraints
and the snapping, but they are not printed or exported to the raster files. They are
drawn dashed. Any object can also be turned into a reference with the option
"Reference object" of its properties, and the references of a layer can be hidden
with "Hide the reference figures". The buttons of this panel are always active.

<image:base64 col="0" width="6" wrap="left"></image:base64><text:style bold="true">Reference line</text:style>
Drag from one point to the other to make a guide line: for instance an axis
of symmetry or a line to measure from.

<image:base64 col="0" width="6" wrap="left"></image:base64><text:style bold="true">Snap to lines</text:style>
A toggle button. When it is down, a point that is clicked on a line (a
reference line too), on a side of a poly-line or on a circle or arc stays
       attached to it by a constraint, and the points that attract are shown with
       small squares. Switch it off to see them disappear.

<image:base64 col="0" width="6" wrap="left"></image:base64><text:style bold="true">Reference point</text:style>
Click to put a point. A point has no size, so it is drawn as a small cross.
